The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Usk (planet)|Usk]],<ref name="EA" /> in the [[Usk system/Legends|Usk system]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> was home to a native [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] '''species'''. At some point, the planet's indigenous inhabitants were [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] was considered part of the region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] known as [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]], controlled by their masters, as early as [[25,127 BBY]]. Some [[Time/Legends|time]] after they were enslaved, the species was driven to [[Death/Legends|extinction]], and, eventually, the name of the species was forgotten by the rest of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species native to Usk were mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="EA" />
